ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) across the medial and proximal regions, with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the distal lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-contrast white mottling is localized on the outer 25% of both lobes. The central region near the median notch is solid black. Punctate white spots are visible along the trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A wide, symmetrical V-shaped depression with a shallow depth-to-width ratio and an approximate interior angle of 120 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations are visible along the trailing edge, becoming more irregular and jagged at the extreme distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a gentle convex curve from the median notch to the tips, with a slight upward vertical sweep at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular white pixel groups are visible on the ventral distal tips of both lobes, particularly prominent on the left tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical high-contrast linear marks are visible on the mid-ventral surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct cluster of reddish-brown pigmented pixels is visible on the posterior edge of the right lobe tip, indicating a possible lesion or recent trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific density and distribution of white mottling at the extreme tips relative to the solid black center is the primary unique identifier.
